help.title: About Agent report
help.overview: Agent report is a period performance view: what each agent reserved, sold, and earned in commissions between two dates. It is reporting, not the commission ledger. Changing a deal after the fact changes the next refresh of this report.

sections.title: On this page
items: Pick a period (or from/to dates) and apply.
Read per-agent rows; export when you need a file.

sections.title: How it behaves
items: Figures come from Reservations, Sales, and Commissions in the date range.
It does not pay anyone — use Commissions to manage payout status (pending / paid / voided).
It does not create reservations or sales.
